details.completeness_justification: K1, K2, K3, K4, K5, and K7 are PRESENT with supporting sentences identified. K6 and K8 are MISSING as there is no mention of the Russia-Ukraine war impacts or environmental sustainability metrics. The summary captures most core financial and operational highlights, but the absence of two HIGH importance items (K6) and one MEDIUM importance item (K8) prevents a 'Yes' rating. The overall picture is captured, but key contextual and strategic elements are omitted.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. It presents a consistent narrative of improved performance despite lower revenue, with clear explanations for revenue decline (icebreaker Botnica charter fees) and offsetting factors (higher vessel dues, passenger fees, etc.). All financial metrics (revenue, expenses, profits) show logical directional changes that align with the stated causes. The structure progresses logically from revenue to expenses to profitability metrics, then to volumes and investments, ending with outlook. There are no self-contradictions, logical gaps, or organizational problems. While there is a minor numerical discrepancy between operating expenses (S5: EUR 88.0m) and the sum of its components (S6 implies operating expenses alone fell 10%), this is not an internal contradiction because the candidate does not claim these components are exhaustive or that they should sum to the total. The summary maintains internal logical coherence throughout.
